stimulus: Once a rich banker said to a poor cobbler. How much do you earn a year The cobbler replied laughing I never count in this way I earn barely enough to pass a day And I’m happy Are really happy said the banker Part B : Composition (20 Marks)
guide_solution: Once a rich banker said to a poor cobbler, “How much do you earn a year?” The cobbler replied laughing, “I never count in this way. I earn barely enough to pass a day. And I am happy.” “Are you really happy?” said the banker.
